moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio follow, written here): Card drops in y −60 → 0 px on a spring (k 170, c 18: 5 % overshoot, ~500 ms); its shadow lands 50 ms later, title bar 60 ms, two text lines 100 / 140 ms, all on the same spring (recipe: parent 600 ms power2.out, shadow +40, title +80, subtitle +120 ms). Site exit: all rise 30 px and fade, 300 ms. Params: spring (k 170, c 18) · y (−60 px) · delays (50 / 60 / 100 / 140 ms).
